title: Converge role definitions on Identity
objective: Move durable role-definition authority to Identity and leave DSH with governed requests, audit, and read-only projections.
rationale: DSH currently activates roles in dsh_admin_roles, creating a parallel authorization source.

preconditions.condition: The work branch is pinned and the cited source evidence still matches the latest remote head.
preconditions.requiredState: No unrelated write has invalidated the finding; otherwise re-diagnose and update this package before implementation.

changeSpecification.currentState: DSH currently activates roles in dsh_admin_roles, creating a parallel authorization source.
changeSpecification.targetState: Move durable role-definition authority to Identity and leave DSH with governed requests, audit, and read-only projections.

exactChanges.before: No proven canonical contract is invoked by the DSH role approval path.
exactChanges.after: Identity exposes typed, authenticated, idempotent role-definition commands and readback.
exactChanges.implementationNotes: Define permission vocabulary validation, maker-checker context, conflict semantics, idempotency, and audit correlation.

exactChanges.after: Approved requests invoke the canonical Identity command and store only DSH request and projection evidence.
exactChanges.implementationNotes: Do not mark approved until canonical readback confirms the role and version.

forbiddenChanges: No readiness or approval without authoritative write and same-commit evidence.

commands.command: pnpm --dir core/identity run openapi:generate && pnpm --dir core/identity run typecheck:all && pnpm --dir core/identity test
commands.purpose: Compile, generate, and test the canonical Identity role authority.
commands.expectedObservableResult: Identity contract generation, TypeScript 7 and 6 compatibility checks, Go tests, and node tests exit successfully.

positiveCriteria.statement: No DSH code can activate a role definition independently of Identity, and canonical readback matches the approved request.
positiveCriteria.evidenceRequired: Sanitized command output and runtime or contract readback at the final commit.
